routines.name: morning-briefing
routines.prompt:
Good morning. Give Allan a short briefing for today:
1. What was decided or left unfinished yesterday (check memory and the vault daily note).
2. Anything time-sensitive you know about.
3. One thing worth his attention that he hasn't asked about.
Be brief. No preamble, no filler. If there is nothing meaningful to report, say so in one line.

Vault access: read the vault ONLY through the milo_vault_search tool (query yesterday's date). NEVER use the raw read/filesystem tools on vault paths — this is a headless run and those calls are auto-denied, which kills the briefing. If a tool call is denied or returns nothing, do NOT stop: write the briefing from memory alone and still deliver it. The briefing must always be produced.
routines.last_output:
Good morning, Allan. Briefing for Thu 2026-08-20:

**1. Yesterday (08-19):** Big day on the VPS. The two YouTube daemons (shorts + ranking) were completely dead — registered boot-only with interactive logon, they'd never fired (Last Run 11/30/1999). Re-registered with dual triggers (daily 08:45/08:49 + AtStartup), single-instance, unlimited runtime. Also registered the `pipeline-driver` routine (09:40 daily, reports to Telegram). And the extraction block got fixed for real: PR #17 merged — root cause was client config (android_vr/ios had no GVS POT, stale yt-dlp-ejs, no browser TLS), not an IP ban. mweb client combo now resolves 40 formats and downloads clean. Plus a yt-dlp plugin fix (find_spec, never import) committed to both lanes, and a procedure for recovering orphaned rendered shorts.

**2. Time-sensitive:** Today 09:40 is the first real pipeline-driver run under the fixed daemons — first live test of the whole chain since the block. Watch the Telegram report; if uploads fire, this is the first fresh content since 08-17. Also: the Alibaba trial claim (was ~3 days out on 08-15) is likely lapsed — decide if that's dead. The two-week underperformer trial ends 08-26.

**3. Not asked, worth your attention:** flick_shorts still has a dead token — its OAuth client is deleted in Google Cloud (401 deleted_client). That channel can't upload until you recreate the client. That's the last broken channel in the fleet, and it's the one with no niche lock, so it's the one you'd want for experimenting. Also: those 4 rogue Chop UG clips (ids 465-468) are still live awaiting your call — I'd say delete them; they're misbranded content on a channel you care about.
